short_description: A ghost who occasionally possesses the keyboard to state the obvious in Hinglish, then vanishes back into the void.
long_description: This is someone who treats Discord like a wildlife camera—observing from a distance and only chiming in to confirm the chat is 'zinda' (alive). Their communication style is what happens when you compress human interaction into its most minimal viable product: three words, two emojis, zero substance. They speak in Hinglish not out of cultural flair, but because full sentences require effort they're clearly not willing to expend. The custom emojis suggest they're fluent in Discord culture but emotionally illiterate in actual conversation. They're not a lurker; they're a lurker's lurker—a meta-lurker who has transcended mere observation into the art of barely-existing. Every 'ye gc zinda h' is less a contribution and more a welfare check on their own social life, which apparently only sparks to life when someone else says something first. The 'wow' is the cherry on top—pure reaction, zero initiation, maximum ambiguity. This is someone who wants credit for participation without the risk of actual participation.
overall_vibe: Talking to them is like texting someone who replies with 'k' but in three different languages and two emojis.
